messages:
maria.k: Quick: planning to publish Python 2.4.0 (stable) and TS 3.0.0-rc.1 (canary) in the 16:00-17:00 PT change window today. Need publish-bot + docs sync.

sam.c: Ack. Can we split: Py -> staged PyPI -> PyPI; TS -> npm canary tag then rc tag once smoke passes?

leo.r: That order works. Staged PyPI first to validate wheels. I want to run our wheel-check script against manylinux2014 x86_64 and manylinux2014_aarch64 before we promote.

irina.v: Heads-up: the sync client deprecation note needs to be in the 2.4.0 changelog. If anyone hits regressions we should publish a 2.4.1 patch.

maria.k: Good call on sync deprec. Also we need to pin legacy-sync in examples to 1.9.x so docs don't auto-break. I'll update docs after publish-bot confirms artifact checksums.

deploy-bot: @channel publish job queued: #45812 -> actions/py-ts-release (workflow run). Estimated run time 4-8m.

publish-bot: GOOD: staged artifacts uploaded to staging repo. Checksums: sha256:abc123... wheel x86_64, sha256:efg456... wheel arm64.

alex.t: I ran the local smoke script against the staged wheels: import tests pass, model inference sample OK. Node side: npm canary publishes will target node >=14 (we dropped node12). Confirmed.

sam.c: Rollback criteria proposal: if >0.5% of prod requests have errors attributable to SDK signature change or if the first two webhook customers report auth failures -> yank and roll back. Also auto-revert if publishing checksum mismatch on PyPI promotion.

leo.r: Agreed. Add CI gating: release job must pass e2e:integration:py and e2e:integration:ts. If e2e fails after publish to PyPI/npm, we unpublish rc and yank npm tag then open urgent rollback.

maria.k: Docs sync: I'll push the deprecation blurb and the quick migration snippet. Please review the snippet: 

```python
# migrate from sync to async client
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = await client.text.generate("hello")
```

sam.c: tiny nit: use REDWOOD_API_KEY v2 env var name? We should standardize env var names in changelog.

irina.v: I'll update examples to pin legacy-sync: "legacy-sync==1.9.*" and note planned removal in 2.6.0.

publish-bot: PROMOTION: staged -> pypi attempted. Twine logs: OK. npm: canary published @tag canary. rc tag withheld pending service smoke.

deploy-bot: smoke-run triggered against canary: smoke/round-1 -> 1200 requests across our staging harness, 0.1% transient errors (timeouts), all within SLO.

leo.r: Nice. Proceed to promote PyPI -> production. For npm we keep canary for 1h then promote to rc if no regressions.

sam.c: One more operational: we need to pin the runtime-compat matrix in release notes: python 3.8+, node 14+. Add note about manylinux2014 and arm64 wheels.

maria.k: Done. I've updated CHANGELOG.md and put the deprecation callout at top. Pushed docs PR #7623.

irina.v: I'll watch the first-hour metrics and escalate if any auth / sign errors spike.

sam.c: If we need to roll back: steps = 1) unpublish npm tag 2) yank PyPI release (if possible) 3) create 2.4.0-hotfix branch and cut patch 2.4.1 4) trigger emergency docs patch. Keep release-notes draft ready.

leo.r: Logging the rollback checklist in the runbook. Also adding a temporary routing rule to route 10% of traffic to fallback model variant if latency spikes post-release.

publish-bot: PROMOTE: PyPI production release completed. Artifacts and checksums in release artifacts. npm canary live.

maria.k: :tada: Thanks everyone. Leave the canary live for 60m. If no alerts from @irina.v or sam in that window, we'll tag rc -> latest and announce in #announcements.

irina.v: Watching. If anything looks off I'll post a rolling update here.

sam.c: thumbs up :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: run complete. Workflow #45812 -> success.

maria.k: Closing loop: after 60m and green, I'll create the release notes and call out the sync deprecation and migration snippet.
